# crewmate

> crewmate is a CLI that watches GitHub PRs and issues for `@crewmate` mentions and replies with AI-generated explanations (`crewmate watch`), or streams new mentions as NDJSON for an agent to handle (`crewmate stream`).

Important notes:

- Install with `npm install -g crewmate`. Requires Node.js 24+, an authenticated GitHub CLI (`gh`), and (for `watch`) a `claude`-shaped provider CLI.
- Development of this repository requires [Nub](https://nubjs.com).

## Implementation

- [src/bin.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YogliB/crewmate/main/src/bin.ts): CLI entry point.
- [src/index.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YogliB/crewmate/main/src/index.ts): CLI, poll loop, and job runner; default-exports `run`.
